sn16.10:1.7: “Come, Honorable Kassapa. Let’s go to one of the quarters of the nuns.”
sn16.10:1.8: “You go, Reverend Ānanda. You’re the one with many duties and responsibilities.”
sn16.10:3.4: In the same way, the venerable Mahākassapa thinks he can teach Dhamma in front of the venerable Ānanda, the Videhan sage.”
